text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling fire impact determinants and future fire risk under climate and land-use scenarios. While it uses land-use change projections as an input for scenario analysis, its primary research objective is not LULC prediction. It fails the core inclusion criteria because its central focus is fire impact modeling, not LULC prediction/simulation. Furthermore, it does not implement or produce its own national-scale LULC predictions; it uses existing projections from another model (Otimizagro) as one of several scenario inputs.)
